model: R260-R263 formal positive two-choice affine BRC with source DFA; six formal coordinate slots; NONNATIVE
principal_theorem: Minimum number of time-homogeneous positive-rational affine-labelled BRC control states with fixed (q,h) terminal labels and full actual effect histogram is 7
proof: Any d-control candidate has a 2d-dimensional rational lift via rho(eps,k)=diag(2^k,2^-k)*J^((1-eps)/2); scalar s_m=sum_k H_m(0,1,+,k)2^k; rank of 13-by-13 Hankel K nonzero, hence 2d>=13. Reachable 7-state product realizes the exact histogram for all m.
open_question: Can effect-conditioned nonlinear/variable terminal decoding under a precisely declared interface use fewer than 7 counted control states without hidden side channels? Need native R193 and module correspondence.
